$comment: The API changelog (public-api: The changelog page and the release notes). A pull request that announces something about the API adds a dated entry under unreleased: a breaking change released without notice, allowed only for an urgent security fix, needs the api-breaking label, an entry of kind breaking and a bump of info.version in openapi/v1.json (public-api: The `api-breaking` label for urgent security fixes). Before the packet schema is published, a breaking packet change needs the api-breaking label and an entry of kind breaking with "schemas": ["packet"], dated the day it is announced, and no release contains it until 14 days later (handoff-packet: Breaking packet changes before publication). The maintainers' decision to graduate an operation to stable is an entry of kind graduation that names it in operationIds, dated the day they decided: an operation other than contract.report carries x-stability-level stable only with one, decided at least four weeks after the last breaking change to it and after the release that first offered it, and pnpm check:graduation fails without it (public-api: Each operation graduates on its own). Entries are shown with the release that carries them, on /docs/api/changelog and in the release notes.

unreleased.text: Every operation that takes a body may answer 503 with the new problem type busy and Retry-After: 5, when the web process is already receiving as many request bodies as it holds at once, 64 MiB. The body was not read and nothing ran, so the same call can be sent again after that time.
